body.name: P_h_pair
body.construction: For \(0<h\leq1/4\), define clean binary-outcome laws \(P_{0,h}\) and \(P_{1,h}\) by \(X\sim\operatorname{Unif}([0,1])\), \(u(x)=1/2\), \(e(x)=x^2/2\), \(Y\mid(X=x,A=0)\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(1/2)\), \(Y\mid(X=x,A=1)\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(\mu_{1,j}(x))\), \(\mu_{1,0}(x)=1/2\), and \(\mu_{1,1}(x)=1/2+(h-x)_+/4\). Let \(t=\operatorname{TV}(P_{0,h},P_{1,h})\), and let \(S_+\) and \(S_-\) be the probability normalizations of the positive and negative parts of \(P_{1,h}-P_{0,h}\). Whenever \(\epsilon>0\) and \(t\leq\epsilon/(1-\epsilon)\), set \(c=(1-\epsilon)t/\epsilon\), \(H=P_{0,h}\), \(Q_{0,h}=cS_++(1-c)H\), \(Q_{1,h}=cS_-+(1-c)H\), and \(R_h=(1-\epsilon)P_{0,h}+\epsilon Q_{0,h}=(1-\epsilon)P_{1,h}+\epsilon Q_{1,h}\).
